behavior.arguments: rdi = struct pointer, sil = byte index (zero-extended)

edges.index_7_already_set: field unchanged when the bit is already set

behavior.formula: field+0x1a0 |= table[byte_index], where table is the 20-entry u32 table at 0x2516ec
behavior.output_shape: no return value; the field is updated in place, then ret
behavior.table_entries_20_and_above: entry 20 is 0x01314a6c (eleven bits set), not a single-bit mask; no flag interpretation is claimed for indices >= 20
behavior.table_permutation: the first 20 entries are single bits 0..19, in order: indices 0-7 -> bits 0-7, index 8 -> bit 9, index 9 -> bit 11, indices 10-17 -> bits 12-19, index 18 -> bit 8, index 19 -> bit 10

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_slots_note: four R_X86_64_RELATIVE records in .rela.dyn name this window as addend; the file stores 0 in those .data.rel.ro slots, applied only at load time
